Settings driven by the product's config catalog: typed controls, categories, search above twelve rows, provenance as text, locked rows set by an organization, and reset. A locked setting shows its value as text with a lock, never as a dimmed control.

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Python)">
    <KitStatus kit="terminal-python" />

    **Drop-in.** `config` (`list`, `get`, `set`, `reset`).

    **Styled part.** `screens.settings(kit, view)` in `polaris_key.ui.terminal`, drawn with a `Kit`; restyle through
    `Theme(colors=…, symbols=…, preset="native")`.

    **Headless.** `settings_view(entries, local)` → `SettingsView` in `polaris_key.ui.core.models`.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Node)">
    <KitStatus kit="terminal-node" />

    **Drop-in.** `config list` (`configListFlow`): each setting, its value and where it comes from,
    with the operator's locked ones marked (`list`, `locked`); `config get <key>`,
    `config set <key> <value>` and `config reset <key>` (`saving`). `secret <key>` and
    `mint <recipeId>` print a value alone, for scripts.

    **Styled part.** `tableRows`.

    **Headless.** None of its own: the data is `client.config.listUserConfig()` and
    `client.config.getConfigSource(key)`.

    [Terminal (Node)](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/terminal-node/) has the adapter's options, the
    `--json` contract and the fallbacks.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="SwiftUI">
    <KitStatus kit="swiftui" />

    **Drop-in.** A section a host drops into its settings: values as text, locked rows with a lock and `Set by <org>`, never a dimmed switch.

    **Styled part.** `SettingsSection(screen:rows:)`.

    **Headless.** `KitStates.settings(_:)`.

    **On a Mac.** `Settings { PolarisKeySettingsPane(client) }` is the Account tab, and `.commands { PolarisKeyCommands(client) }` adds Manage License… and Sign Out… to the app menu.

    [SwiftUI](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/swiftui/) has the theme, the restyle hooks and the sample.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Electron">
    <KitStatus kit="electron" />

    **Drop-in.** `<Settings />` from `@polaris-key/react/kit`, inside `<PolarisKeyProvider>`: given no `input`, it reads the bridge itself. **Manage license** in the app menu opens it over the app, with a Done button and an Account group.

    **Styled part.** The React kit's `<Settings />`, drawn in the macOS, Windows or GNOME chrome with `theme.platform: "auto"`; restyle through `data-part` and the `--pk-*` hooks.

    **Headless.** `viewOf("Settings", input)`.

    [Electron](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/electron/) has the bridge, the menu and the sample.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Godot">
    <KitStatus kit="godot" />

    <GodotKitTab component="Settings" />

  </TabItem>
</Tabs>
